title: Stable determination of coefficients for the nonlinear third-order acoustic equations
summary: In this paper, we study an inverse boundary value problem for a generalized Jordan-Moore-Gibson-Thompson equation with Westervelt-type nonlinearity and space-dependent coefficients. This third-order (in time) hyperbolic equation models nonlinear ultrasound propagation in viscous and thermally relaxing media. Assuming that the diffusivity and the sound speed are known a priori, we investigate the simultaneous stable determination of the friction coefficient, the weak damping coefficient, the potential, and the nonlinear coefficient from the associated Dirichlet-to-Neumann map.
